label: OpenSky Nearby Planes Radar
info:
Live nearby aircraft with anonymous or environment-based OAuth access.

AirLabs setup in the Node-RED editor: double-click this flow tab, open Environment Variables, click Add, name it AIRLABS_API_KEY, enter the private value, click Done, and Deploy. AirLabs live routes refresh every 5 minutes by default; selected-airport schedules refresh every 2 hours. Never include the populated key when exporting or publishing the flow.

To change OpenSky polling, add OPENSKY_POLL_SECONDS here and set the same interval on the Poll every 5 min Inject node.

name: 1. Edit location defaults in the next function
info: Change center latitude, longitude, and radius in Prepare location, auth & request.

name: Optional: set OPENSKY_CLIENT_ID + OPENSKY_CLIENT_SECRET outside the flow
info: Never paste credentials into this export. Use operating-system, Docker, or service environment variables.
